_comment: Copy to launch_defaults.local.json (gitignored) beside this file, or at the repo root, and edit. tools/sync_launch_targets.ps1 stamps these onto .vs/launch.vs.json, which is gitignored and therefore disposable. 'all' applies to every target; 'targets' keys match the projectTarget label exactly or as a wildcard. Values here win over what is already in launch.vs.json.
_env_reference: Full table with defaults is in README.md under 'Environment variables'. Connection: HONUWARE_DB_HOST (localhost on Windows, postgresql on Linux), _PORT (5432), _USER (docker), _PASSWORD (docker), _NAME (app-supplied; overriding points at a different database), _SSLMODE (prefer in release, unset in debug), _SSLROOTCERT. Every HONUWARE_* name falls back to the legacy KNOTTYYOGA_* name.
_env_reference_set_by_hand: HONUWARE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE (must be exactly "1"; anything else blocks --recreate_database), HONUWARE_SECRET_KEY (mandatory in production, dev fallback locally), HONUWARE_MAIL_APP_PASSWORD (seed time only), SCHEDULER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD (seeding throws if unset), PORT (default differs per app: 18081 communityfinder, 18080 knottyyoga).
_env_reference_rare: HONUWARE_VERSION (health response; falls back to "unknown"), HONUWARE_TENANT_MODE (Fixed default | Control), HONUWARE_FIXED_SITE_KEY (Fixed mode; defaults to the app database name), HONUWARE_CONTROL_DB_NAME (Control mode), HONUWARE_LOG_DEST, HONUWARE_TRUST_PROXY, HONUWARE_ORIGIN_SECRET, HONUWARE_DEV_CORS_ORIGIN, HONUWARE_APP_NAME (theme-bundle export metadata), CURL_CA_BUNDLE.
_not_env_vars: HONUWARE_API_BASE, HONUWARE_CRUD_ACCESS and HONUWARE_MOCK_OPTIONS are Angular DI tokens configured via environment.ts - setting them here does nothing. HONUWARE_SRC_DIR is container-side only; the Windows equivalent is the CMake cache variable FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_HONUWARE.

targets._comment_targets: Wildcards match the full projectTarget label, including the nested 'name.exe (sub\dir\name.exe)' form.
